pre_mortem_narrative: It is late October 2026, just past the 64-day tactical target date of 2026-10-31, and the 'Research More' has clearly failed. The most plausible story is not that copper moved and the engine missed it - a refusal that costs an opportunity is the cheap failure. The expensive failure is this: the run's descriptive layer was quoted downstream as if it were measured, and it was wrong in two places. A reader took the terminal dossier's plain-English line that 'an LME-rolled long is paid roughly 9%-13% to hold the same metal' and built a venue-carry trade on it. The correct band on the run's own inputs is +5.1% to +8.7% - the 3.79% collateral leg was counted twice at both ends, because a NET-CARRY band created in market-structure/02 was re-used as a ROLL-ONLY band in the scenario engine and had collateral added again. The LME cash-3M spread then mean-reverted toward the +US$45/t level it held on 2026-08-11, the roll paid +1.3% not +9%, and the trade earned roughly cash while wearing basis risk. Separately, a risk committee sized the Section 232 exposure at the '~740 kt of US-located metal' the dossier repeats four times, when the run's own measured COMEX registered-plus-eligible figure is 745,277 short tons = 676.1 kt and 69.8% x 968.4 kt = 676.1 kt exactly - the 740 kt is a COMEX-PLUS-LME combined figure from a secondary source whose basis was dropped between the supply-security register row and the headline. The exposure was sized 9.5% too large on a location basis that includes LME's global warehouse network. Neither error changed the action; both were quoted as if they had been measured. The second, quieter failure: the run's central narrative - 'the move has no owner, three lenses, three residuals near 100%' - was read as three independent confirmations when two of the three are refusals to compute (no sourced sensitivity exists), i.e. one absence counted three times. The refusal to rate was right. The confidence attached to the REASONS for it was not fully earned.
bear_case: Kept brief, because for a Research More the bear case is not a position. The strongest credible version of why copper falls from here, assembled only from evidence dated on or before 2026-08-28 and held inside the run's own artifacts: at US$6.62/lb a disclosed high-cost producer earns a 42.6%-47.1% margin over its OWN published all-in sustaining cost (First Quantum AISC US$3.50-3.80/lb, Q1 2026 Results, 2026-04-28, PRIMARY, read) and 58.5%-82.6% over reachable net cash costs - re-derived: (6.62-3.80)/6.62 = 42.60%, (6.62-3.50)/6.62 = 47.13%. There is no cost support anywhere near this market. The supply channels that can respond inside twelve months are already realised and dated, not prospective: scrap-based refined output +5.6% Jan-May 2026, scrap share of world refined output 17.3% to 17.8%, China's scrap share of refined feedstock 25.2% in H1-2026; a Cobre Panama decision window closing 2026-12-31 on ~350 kt/yr idled; named realised aluminium substitution (Ferrari, BMW, EV makers, Daikin, Jun-Jul 2026) with Cu/Al at 4.2-4.3 against an indicative 3.5-4.0 trigger. The realised balance evidence is one-directional and quantified where the forecast balance is not: Q1-2026 +396 kt surplus (386 kt seasonally adjusted), ~2.93x Q1-2025's +135 kt, landing in visible metal as a +401 kt three-exchange build end-2025 to end-May-2026 (1,145.0 - 744.1 = 400.9 kt, re-derived); visible stock +30.1% YTD (968.4/744.1 = 1.3015). Macro pushed the other way the whole time: the US 10-year real yield rose 54bp to 2.36%, a multi-decade high, and China fixed-asset investment ran -6.7% with property -19.2%, both worsening. The speculative book is at the 98.7th percentile of 156 weekly COT reports with gross shorts at the 14.7th percentile, so there is essentially no natural bid obliged to buy a fall. And the price sits at roughly the 100th percentile of its own five-year INFLATION-ADJUSTED range. What stops this being a Trim or a short, and the dossier says so correctly: none of it is sized in tonnes, the base rate for every leg is not assessable (N=0 copper price observations against a section 10 floor of 30), there is no bounded downside at either horizon, and the one event that can gap the market 19-22% in a session is undated and fires in EITHER direction.
bull_case_steelman: The fairest, strongest version of the case that a directional view WAS available and that deferring was too cautious. First, this run is not evidence-free in the way the headline 'usable = 0 of 22' implies. Five primary issuer documents were read directly and in full (Capstone 2026 Guidance 2026-02-17; First Quantum 2026-2028 Guidance 2026-01-15 and Q1 2026 Results 2026-04-28; Antofagasta Q2 2026 Production Report 2026-07-15 and 2026 Half Year Results 2026-08-13) - genuine tier-1 primary cost evidence against a run-wide measured primary coverage of 0.0%, and it is what makes the cost floor a real band rather than an assertion. Second, the CFTC disaggregated COT was not merely reachable but fully retrieved - 156 weekly observations plus the current report - and it reconciles to open interest TO THE LOT on both sides (I re-derived it: long 92,097+25,262+28,940+52,125+8,658+19,302+35,071 = 261,455, +20,108 non-reportable = 281,563 = OI; short side likewise; the five class nets sum to exactly zero). Every percentile in the positioning read is therefore measured on a real three-year history, not asserted. The positioning orb concedes the point itself: this is 'the one required row in this entire run that is blocked purely by the absence of a vintage, not by a licence, a paywall or a missing dataset'. Third, four of the strongest evidence items all point the SAME way - the 43%-47% AISC margin (primary), the realised Q1 surplus, the dated live supply-response channels, and the 100th-percentile real-terms price. A thesis in which the primary-sourced evidence, the realised balance and the valuation lens agree is not nothing. Fourth, a purist could argue the machine contract is doing the work rather than the evidence: 'usable = 0/22' is a statement about vintages and connectors, and a vintage is a provenance property, not a truth property. The CFTC public API is a primary regulator publication; the five issuer PDFs are audited-adjacent primary disclosures. A framework that discards them entirely is capable of refusing to rate a company whose 10-K it has read. Where I land, honestly: the steelman fails on ONE thing and it is decisive. Not one of those items supplies a return distribution. Without it there is no P10, no P90, no loss probability, no bounded downside and no risk/reward - and copper's largest identified event is undated, unmeasured in magnitude (three unverified secondary sources give 19%/20%/22% for one session, N=1, disagreeing by 3pp) and two-sided. That is a reason to have no position, not a directional view. The upside this pre-mortem is dismissing is real and should be recorded rather than buried: the cheapest coverage row in the profile is one free public-API vintage away from being fixed.
